blocks.text: Foz do Iguaçu: Brazilian Falls, Macuco Safari, Bird Park and helicopter flight

provenance.rationale: Combine the approved destination with its listed Brazilian-side activities, removing the days 10-11 prefix.

blocks.text:
Day 11 · Breakfast. A full day of excursions begins on the Brazilian side of the falls, along the canyon of the Iguaçu River, within a national park of unique flora and fauna. The name means “big water” in Guarani: 275 waterfalls, each with its own name, thunder down into the Devil’s Throat gorge in a halo of rainbows, as you walk past numerous smaller falls towards the most powerful of all.

Macuco Safari · Cross the jungle by jeep with a guide, continue on foot to a platform on the Iguaçu River, then board a specially equipped boat that takes you close to, and beneath, the falls, with unique views of the cascades and the forested slopes.

Bird Park · Near Iguaçu National Park, walk through huge aviaries in the subtropical forest, where birds of extraordinary colours fly freely around you; the park is also home to caimans, monkeys and other animals.

Helicopter flight · A unique panoramic flight over the falls, taking off near the national park on the Brazilian side.
